title: 'The Devil's Plan: Dead Again' Premieres November 10 — Teaser Trailer Marks the Return of the Showdown
summary: From reigning brain survival legends to fierce newcomers, The Devil's Plan: Dead Again sets a bigger stage for unpredictable twists, where only one will prevail.
body_markdown:
From reigning brain survival legends to fierce newcomers,


The Devil's Plan: Dead Again


sets a bigger stage for unpredictable twists, where only one will prevail. While Season 2 centered on space with its "Death Room" concept (The Devil’s Plan: Death Room), Season 3’s subtitle, "Dead Again," tantalizingly hints at the high-stakes comeback of survival veterans who have already tasted "death" (elimination) and are ready to risk it all again.


Along with the premiere date announcement, the newly released main poster features a powerhouse 16-player lineup that promises pure dopamine for brain survival fans. The tagline, "The Return. The Real Showdown," sets the stage for an unprecedented clash of masterminds.


-


Jang Dongmin:


The undisputed "God of Survival Shows” with a record five consecutive victories.


-


Hong Jinho:


Top-tier professional poker player with over $2.3M in career earnings.


-


Oh Hyunmin:


KAIST(Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology)-educated "human calculator" and part of the legendary "Jang-Oh Alliance."


-


Ha Seok-jin:


Champion of


The Devil’s Plan Season 1


.


-


Jeong Hyun-gyu:


Champion of T


he Devil’s Plan: Death Room (Season 2)


.


-


Kim Dong-jae


: Standout of


The Devil's Plan Season 1


contender and world-class poker player.


-


XITSUH:


Sharp-witted rapper and veteran of


Game of Blood Seasons 2 & 3


.


-


Yurisa:


Mensa member (IQ 156), Winner of the Asian Ladies poker tournament, only after six months after learning the game.


-


SHINDONG:


Master of sharp deductive instincts from


Great Escape


.


-


Hyun Kyunglyul:


Google engineer with a Ph.D. from SNU (Seoul National University) who dominated


Society Game


.


-


John Park:


Northwestern graduate and champion of


The Time Hotel


.


-


JAE JAE:


The core mastermind behind


High School Mystery Club


.


-


Nucksal:


18-year veteran rapper and avid board game enthusiast.


-


Yi Do:


Star instructor and SNU graduate.


-


Stella Jang:


Multilingual singer and songwriter prodigy fluent in four languages.


-


Jung Wonyoung:


Hidden powerhouse who conquered internal corporate survivals and board game tournaments alike.


The accompanying teaser trailer offers a thrilling preview of high-stakes mind games and intricate psychological warfare. "It’s totally different now," reacts SHINDONG, capturing the fresh surprises in store. Beyond the intimidation factor of returning veterans, the show highlights the hidden firepower of these first-time survival players. In particular, Jang Dongmin’s ruthless confidence, declaring, "I’m gonna wipe them all out anyway?" signals an all-out mental war where victory is the only option.


The Devil’s Plan: Dead Again


is already generating massive buzz for delivering the dream lineup that brain survival fans have long wished for. Crafted under the signature direction of Producer Jung Jong-yeon, the show promises edge-of-your-seat entertainment packed with strategic brilliance, raw psychology, and pure adrenaline.


The Devil’s Plan: Dead Again


premieres globally November 10, only on Netflix.
